components/filters/ChipGallery.tsx.name: Shape picker chips
components/filters/ChipGallery.tsx.description: Shows a row of tappable chips with diamond-shape images so customers can quickly filter by shape.

components/filters/CollapsibleSection.ts.name: Filter group
components/filters/CollapsibleSection.ts.description: A collapsible panel that groups related filter options together, like metal type or price range.

components/filters/EnhancedFilterSummary.name: Active filter tags
components/filters/EnhancedFilterSummary.description: Shows small tags for every filter the customer has chosen, each with an X to remove it.

components/filters/FilterHeaderBar.tsx.name: Filter & sort bar
components/filters/FilterHeaderBar.tsx.description: The bar above product listings with a filter button, sort dropdown and a count of matching results.

components/filters/FiltersDrawer.tsx.name: Filter drawer
components/filters/FiltersDrawer.tsx.description: Slides out from the side to show all available filters: shape, metal, price, stone size and more.

components/filters/FilterSections.tsx.name: Filter options
components/filters/FilterSections.tsx.description: Renders each group of filter choices — checkboxes, sliders and swatches — inside the filter drawer.

components/filters/LuxuryFilterButton.ts.name: Filter button
components/filters/LuxuryFilterButton.ts.description: A styled button that opens the filter drawer, showing how many filters are active.

components/filters/SectionSelectedCount..name: Selected count badge
components/filters/SectionSelectedCount..description: Shows a small number next to a filter group name indicating how many options are selected.
